blocks.text: THE DAY THE. WORLD CHANGED - The Scripts predicted around the year 2000 civilization would be visited by powerful changes, even on the brink of panic and perplexity. Even the news report said the same. In the year 2001, 9-11, this occurred! Our congressmen and authorities said much the same! They have not seen anything yet compared to what will transpire in the future. You might say this, after the translation the greater of these will occur. — Also God will work among His children with sudden changes in a spiritual way, with new understanding in knowledge and power. We’re in a great outpouring soon reaching this point, Matt.25: 1-10 (midnight cry) and James 5:8-10 (the latter rain). Soon each of His children will be guided and anointed in a way they have never known. Future fear will not move them. His presence is so powerful around them!

PROPHECY CONTINUES -— In the future five more powerful events will shake and shape this planet. This part will occur before the great tribulation. It will concern the four elements (weather, etc.), economic, political, religion, the heavens, and of course, geological upheavals within the sea and earth. All of this includes society, terrorists, plus violence, and you might say, wholesale wickedness and worldwide madness. We already know the heathen rage, but it now effects every nation. Planetary disorder is on its way.

THE GREAT APOSTLE— Paul gives us a headline view of our age and he was certainly right. We’re living and passing this period of prophecy. - I Timothy 4: 1, “Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils.” Also Paul shows us the latter times. Important — read JJ Tim. 3: 1-5. This is exactly where the age is at! .... Keep your Bible and scripts at hand. Pray fervently for our youth and the children too! The key word is watch and pray!

MYSTERIES OCCURRING - Strange days indeed! — Magazine quote: “A snake managed to escape from the claws of an eagle and fell into a car near Khaf in the Iranian province of Khorassan, where it bit four passengers. Two were killed instantly and two others injured and taken to the local hospital.” — In a recent news report: “Bird the Size of a Plane Spotted in Alaska?”- ANCHORAGE, Alaska (Reuters News Service) — A bird the size of a small airplane was recently spotted flying over southwest Alaska, puzzling scientists, the Anchorage Daily News reported. The newspaper quoted residents in the villages of Togiak and Manokotak as saying the creature, like something out of the movie “Jurassic Park,” had a wingspan of 14 feet — making it the size of a small airplane.” (The ice is melting fast in Alaska, but it seemed like a prehistoric bird!) “At first I thought it was one of those old-time Otter planes,” the paper quoted a heavy equipment operator from Togiak as saying. “Instead of continuing towards me, it banked to the left, and that’s when I noticed it wasn’t a plane.” He said the bird disappeared over the hill and he then radioed Togiak residents to tell them to keep their children in. Another local resident, a pilot, said he recently saw the bird from a distance of just 1,000 feet while flying his airplane. “The people in the plane saw him,” the pilot was quoted as saying. “He’s huge, he’s really, really big! You wouldn’t want to have your children out.”

SIGNS OF THE HEAVENS - Luke 21: 11, “...and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.” We quote here from a magazine some worldwide sightings. WASHINGTON, D.C.: July 26, 2002. 1:00 a.m. NORAD radar detects UFOs over the District of Columbia and Maryland, forcing D.C. Air National Guard F-16s to scramble out of Andrews Air Force Base. Witnesses describe a light-blue object that looks like a “shooting star with no trailing mist,” traveling at phenomenal speed over the region. Controllers are unable to establish radio communication with the unidentified “craft,” and order the F-16s with air-to-air missiles to intercept. The UFOs track fades from radar screens, and the fighters return to base. — BRITISH COLUMBIA: West Vancouver. 7:05 a.m. June 29, 2002. A “stingray”- shaped sphere is observed “gliding” over the city, swooping down over a nearby lake and then climbing towards the northwest before disappearing into the clouds. Witnesses watch the object depart through binoculars and report the UFO is gray/black on one side. - CALIFORNIA: Edwards Air Force Base. July 26, 2002. 3:43 am. An extremely bright light is seen in the sky approximately 1,000 feet over the air base. The light emanates steadily and moves slowly north for two minutes, followed by two aircraft. The light suddenly blinks out, very close to one of the aircraft. - MISSOURI: Kansas City. July 2, 2002. And air freight pilot flying out of Kansas City International Airport observes a solid oval UFO, with no blinking or colored lights, moving rapidly across the sky from east to west. The object is about the size of a dime held at arm’s length, and travels an estimated 300 miles in less than three minutes time, at an altitude in excess of 50,000 feet. A soft white silhouette light illuminates the object, which does not show up on air traffic control radar. End quote. “There are significant lights and as I said before, I even got to witness some lights here at Capstone. — Prophecy marches on!”

DIVINE LOVE— J John 4: 16, “God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.” - An outpouring of divine love is coming as He returns. The Elect for the first time in our era will be given the most divine love ever, and be filled with it in the days ahead in this restoration we are now in. The Elect will actually feel the impact. What an incredible uplift when He binds together His children, symbolic of this heavenly Scripture, Job 38: 31, “Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?” — Jesus is honey in the rock! Psalms 81: 16. (Also read Psalms Chapter 103 and Psalms Chapter 134.) — Everything in this age will be distorted, and will be even more so ahead. God’s word and work is a treasure! Therefore we must handle it carefully. Be steadfast and confident with it!
